title: Security & Multi-Deployment Update

items: Hardened authentication and protected sensitive API endpoints.
Removed the shared JWT fallback secret.
JWT authentication now fails closed when a deployment has no configured signing key.
Removed sensitive authentication/debug information from application logs.
Protected system settings and administrative operations with proper authorization.
Added **Assessor Security Setup** for new WordPress installations.
Automatically generates a unique cryptographic JWT signing key per deployment.
Added a unique installation ID for each deployment.
Added **Reinitialize as New Deployment** for cloned WordPress installations.
Reinitialization generates a new installation identity and JWT key without affecting assessor records.
Existing JWT sessions are automatically invalidated when a deployment is reinitialized.
Added a safe public `bootstrap-settings` endpoint for pre-login branding and application initialization.
Prevented unauthenticated `/settings` requests during login and application startup.
Preserved protected full settings access for authorized users.
Improved compatibility across different user roles during application initialization.
JWT secrets are stored in `wp-config.php` rather than the database.
Added a secure manual configuration fallback for environments where `wp-config.php` cannot be written automatically.
Deployment-specific secrets are never exposed through the React frontend or REST API.

features: Hardened authentication and protected administrative settings endpoints with strict role authorization.
Enforced deployment-specific cryptographic JWT signing keys, eliminating shared fallback secrets.
Added Multi-Deployment Security Setup and seamless Reinitialization support for cloned installations.
Introduced a safe public bootstrap-settings endpoint to resolve pre-login 401 errors while preserving branding.
Secured environment configuration by storing deployment keys in wp-config.php rather than database options.
Added Memoranda Templates feature to quickly insert predefined text into property memoranda
Optimized layout of 'View' button in Property Table for long declarant names
Fixed navigation drawer title truncation by increasing drawer width slightly
Fixed overlapping loading spinner in tables by putting it inside a clean elevated card, then removed it and adjusted loading logic to not block UI unnecessarily
Fixed table row stretching on small result sets by removing height: 100% on tables
Implement a fix for request management backend scripts and frontend modal with table components
Establish application theme and initial component architecture with layout, data tables
Minor fixes for the UI, request signatories, modal layout overhaul.
Updated system to fully support globally unique 26-character string ULIDs instead of integer IDs
Fixed audit trail ID wrapping by preventing nowrap in the UI table
Fixed audit trail saving by updating database schema and ULID length
Added migration script to automatically backfill states for existing older properties
Fixed an issue where missing table columns for locations prevented options from loading on fresh installs
Fixed backend fatal errors that caused 'Network issue' when saving properties and CORS issues during deletion.
Implemented automatic bidirectional auto-cancellation logic: regardless of entry order, superseded properties automatically switch to CANCELLED state.
Fixed table creation for property states and settings on strict MySQL environments.
Added support for Notification Bell and Changelog.
Fixed ETRACS property table local synchronization to show correct properties.
Fixed Local Property states so that they accurately reflect CURRENT and CANCELLED pills based on their superseded status.
Initial web app deployment.
Support for creating, reading, updating and deleting local properties.
Full API endpoints connected.
